people.name: Baal-hanan
people.line: An overseer of olive and sycamore trees under David.

people.name: Gederah
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Baal-hanan and Jozabad

people.name: Joash
people.line: An official in charge of David's olive and sycamore trees

translations.web: and over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite; and over the cellars of oil was Joash;
translations.bsb: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the foothills. Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.
